text: The authors call the requirement for exploration guarantees a major gap: little is known about how serious exploration hacking is or how to prevent it, yet the sketch depends on avoiding it. They call for developing and testing interpretability, singular learning theory and more prosaic approaches, building model organisms of exploration hacking, and possibly addressing gradient hacking for very superhuman systems.
title: Open: how serious is exploration hacking and how can it be prevented?
